terrain:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: production background for a modern pixel-art fantasy tactical RPG world map, no UI or text.
Input image 1 is a GEOGRAPHIC TOPOLOGY REFERENCE, not a stylistic reference. Rebuild its entire art into polished modern pixel art. Keep the same portrait 7:8 composition and approximate regional placements. Deliver portrait 1792x2048 if possible.
Design a beautifully art-directed, detailed but readable top-down overworld. Crisp square pixel clusters, coherent pixel scale, rich limited palette, carefully shaded terrain, directional upper-left lighting, no anti-aliased painterly strokes. Intended logical pixel canvas 896x1024, 2x nearest-neighbor presentation. Modern indie RPG craft. World age is fantasy, not contemporary; “modern” refers to visual quality.
Geography: a tall Western continent on the left (x 4–50 percent, y 12–94 percent), central deep turquoise strait, and a genuinely separated Eastern island chain on the right (x 62–98 percent, y 12–98 percent). Preserve useful bays and avoid geometric polygons. Western south has an alpine snow valley and snowy pine forest around (22%,89%), graduating into emerald pine forests, fertile terraced farmland and rolling meadow at (18%,72%), military hill country at (35%,70%), a natural coastal city bay at (45%,53%), a little inland mountain lake at (29%,53%), northern snowy ridgelines and narrow valleys at (22%,39%), and green royal uplands around (37%,21%). On the eastern larger northern island: warm sand dunes and a pale salt flat around (76%,45%), a sandy southern harbor cove at (89%,54%), warm rocky hills, oasis palms, with a dark teal reedy tidal marsh at (79%,30%), then broken ancient terraces beside a sunken lagoon at (79%,24%). On eastern smaller southern islands: lush wind-lantern island at (83%,92%), reef isle at (80%,72%), lighthouse island at (93%,67%), rocky sea cave isle at (94%,82%). Draw dark reefs, tidal shallows and delicate pixel foam around all islands; occasional small natural rock islets; much calmer water in the central strait for readability.
At the upper center (x 42–68%, y 0–18%): a separate floating sacred plateau in pearly cloud bands, softly glowing amber stone terraces, dramatic elevation, obvious separation from ordinary islands; a narrow ascending stone bridge extending to the royal uplands. A second smaller elevated terrace at (73%,18%) provides eastern approach, another little terrace at (88%,15%) for a library. These are final-chapter sanctum geography, not additional ordinary land.
Draw TERRAIN ONLY. REMOVE all old castle, house, tower, cave-mouth, ship, temple and other landmark icons. REMOVE old neon green roads, sea route lines and ALL place markers. New reusable landmarks and authored routes will be layered programmatically later. Leave small natural open ground clearings at the approximate former building positions without drawing visible placeholders. Roads may only be faint natural terrain clearings, never strong graph connectors.
Render irregular connected mountain ridges, natural tree clusters, continuous cliffs and shorelines, farmland parcels, shaded sand and reeds; terrain supports navigable valleys and passes. Avoid mechanical repetition, big flat untextured green areas, neon green, NES palette, noise/grain, labels, borders, compass, characters, decorative frame, watermarks. Fill the canvas to its edges.
terrain_cleanup:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Edit target: supplied portrait modern pixel-art overworld terrain.
Keep the entire geography, exact island shapes, mountain chains, forests, snow valley, sand, marsh, sea colors and pixel-art style unchanged. Make ONLY these removals: remove all man-made buildings, shrines, columned temple facades, towers and the lighthouse visible on the upper floating plateau and the eastern elevated small terraces and the southeastern lighthouse island. Replace their footprints with matching open natural ground or empty pale stone paving terraces as appropriate. Remove the dark arched cave entrance on the small southeastern rock isle, restoring an intact natural rock arch without a constructed door. Keep natural arches, cliffs, floating-island undersides and existing stone bridges. The upper center sacred plateau remains a bare terraced garden/platform with grass, bushes and golden stone paving, ready for external palace sprites. All other terrain must remain unchanged. Do not add any new features, text, decorative frames, markers or paths. Deliver the same 7:8 portrait aspect ratio. Crisp pixel-art edges preserved.
landmark_refinement:
Use case: style-transfer
Edit target: supplied sixteen-landmark sprite sheet. Keep all sixteen designs and their reading-order positions. Re-render as CLEAN TRUE PIXEL ART at a coherent low pixel density: each building appears to have been hand-drawn on a 64–80 pixel square sprite canvas then enlarged with nearest-neighbor, clearly visible solid square pixel clusters. Remove the smoothly illustrated/high-definition miniature treatment.
Required fixes:
1. Transparent background and completely clean transparency edges. All stray red, pure blue, lime, yellow and white chromakey fringe pixels around the existing silhouettes must disappear. Transparent pixels must have no visible background remnants.
2. All 16 objects must be reduced to occupy no more than 68% of the width and 72% of the height of their respective equal 4x4 grid cells, perfectly centered within each cell. A clear transparent gap surrounds every entire object. No object crosses its cell boundary or touches a neighbor. No clipping.
3. Use restrained teal roofs, sandstone ivory, amber light, cool slate shadows and natural terrain. Preserve full silhouettes: snowy village, forest tent camp, granary fort, prison; military camp, harbor city, coastal fort, snow gate; sun tower, royal capital, cutter, prison galleon; oasis city, observatory, marsh sanctuary, sun palace.
4. No text, numbers, drawn grid, labels or checkerboard. No soft anti-aliased painted edges, no gradients, no blur. This is a production sprite atlas, not an illustration contact sheet. Every object is separated, complete and ready for individual crop extraction.
supplement:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent 4-column x 2-row landmark sprite atlas for a modern pixel-art tactical RPG map.
Create 8 separate complete small overhead pixel-art landmarks. Exactly 4 columns, 2 rows, all equal cells. One landmark centered in each cell with large transparent margins on ALL sides. Genuine transparent background. Crisp chunky square pixel clusters as if drawn at 48–64px per landmark, teal roofs, warm ivory stone, slate shadows, amber upper-left daylight. Readable miniature 3/4 overhead view. No labels, grid, border or characters.
Read left to right:
Row 1: a rocky old mine entrance with timber support frame and a tiny cart on tracks, whole gray rock mound on grass; a friendly woodland clinic, teal roof timber cottage with cream medicinal banner, flower herb pots and forest green grass; a small shadowy village with three teal roof homes and a tall black iron bell on a wooden bell stand, green ground; a broken ancient stone causeway of three low arches with one collapsed gap and half-submerged pillars, cyan water accents.
Row 2: a warm green island village, three timber whitewashed cottages with teal roofs and two small palm trees; a lonely tidal marsh healer hut on wooden stilts, little plank path, reeds and emerald moss ground; a grand ancient library, ivory columned building with teal roof, gold sun medallion and amber windows on a little cloud terrace; a slender limestone lighthouse with amber beacon, teal conical roof and pale rocky green island base.
Strict constraints: all shapes complete and separated, fully transparent between items, clean alpha with no white/blue/red/lime fringing. Sprite silhouettes must fit within 70 percent of each cell. Uniform pixel size across all items. No painted smooth gradients, no overly detailed realistic miniatures. No opaque rectangles or checkerboard.
